preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**5 and 1 <= Y <= 10**5 and 1 <= Z <= 10**5 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, X, Y, Z are between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= 10**3 and 1 <= B <= 10**3 and 1 <= C <= 10**3 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, C are between 1 and 10^3.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(loss, int) and loss >= 0 for loss in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the minimum energy loss.
